search.website_text:
Better Deaths # Better Deaths

Better Deaths is a Dalamud plugin for reviewing FFXIV raid deaths with pull-level context.

Website: https://nainaiowo.github.io/better-deaths/

It helps you review:

- party-wide death order by pull
- fatal events, captured hit details, and overkill context
- HP plus shields before the fatal event
- active player mitigations, shields, debuffs, and target mitigation
- configurable 10-second, 30-second, or 1-minute HP history with source, event, and status snapshots
- What-if mitigation checks using available party tools
- Death Replay, IN BETA, with captured positions, markers, mechanics, and replay controls
- current pull review, widget display, themes, name redaction, and saved pull history

## What It Does

Better Deaths is built around fast raid review. It keeps deaths grouped by pull, shows the timeline in death order, and opens each player into the details that matter for figuring out what happened.

It also includes:

- fatal event summaries with source, action, amount, damage type, and enemy HP at death
- HP plus shields before the fatal event, including shield and HP movement in the lead-up
- mitigation review with active effects, expired context, and calculated mitigation total
- What-if mitigation review for checking how selected available mits would have changed the hit
- configurable 10-second, 30-second, or 1-minute lead-up history with captured events, heals, hits, sources, and status timers
- Death Replay, IN BETA, for reviewing captured movement and mechanics around a selected death
- current pull review and an optional widget with normal and concise display modes
- multiple themes, widget opacity controls, optional scrollbars, and name redaction
- locally saved pull history that remains available after wipes
- chat posts for a selected channel with optional recap links for participating Better Deaths users

## Privacy And Data

Better Deaths does not upload your data. It has no upload functions, telemetry, analytics, webhook, feedback endpoint, or hidden network reporting built into the plugin.

Recorded pulls are saved locally so you can review them after wipes, resets, reloads, or plugin updates. Saved pull files can include player names, jobs, duty names, death timing, HP, shields, damage events, actions, statuses, and mitigation context.

Name Redaction helps with screenshots and shared display, but local saved pull files may still contain the original captured names.

## Screenshots

### Death Timeline

![Better Deaths death timeline](assets/readme/death-timeline.png)

### What-if Mitigation

![Better Deaths What-if mitigation review](assets/readme/what-if-mitigation.png)

### Mitigation Context

![Better Deaths mitigation context](assets/readme/mitigation-context.png)

### Configurable Lead-Up

![Better Deaths configurable lead-up history](assets/readme/lead-up-history.png)

### Death Replay (IN BETA)

![Better Deaths death replay beta](assets/readme/death-replay-beta.png)

### Themes And Widget Preview

![Better Deaths customization and widget preview](assets/readme/customize-themes-widget.png)

## Commands

```text
/betterdeaths
/bd
/bdw
/bdm
/bdr
```

`/bdw` toggles the Death Widget. `/bdm` toggles the DPS Meter widget without stopping capture or resetting the encounter.

`/bdr` resets the active DPS meter encounter in the overworld, saving the result before starting fresh on the next damage. It is unavailable inside duties and does not delete saved encounters.

## Dalamud Repository

Add this custom plugin repository URL in Dalamud:

```text
https://puni.sh/api/repository/nainai
```

Then install `Better Deaths` from Dalamud's plugin installer.

## Notes

Death recap capture works inside duties. The DPS Meter also records overworld combat. PvP capture is not supported.

This is a work in progress raid review tool, so feedback and issue reports are welcome.

Walkthrough
- Added an optional, 17-step walkthrough covering Review, Replay, Widgets, Analyzer, Options, Data, and Updates.

- Reopen it anytime using Walkthrough in the header.

Capture Improvements
- DPS Meter encounters can now start from opening damage without waiting for your character's combat flag.
- Regular content now requires a verified game death notification before recording a death. This should prevent random death detections when dungeon mob packs end or player state disappears.
- Preserved existing death-detection behavior in Extreme, Savage, Ultimate, and Criterion Savage content.

Help Updates
- Added a DPS Meter screenshot to the website and Help Center.
- Clarified name redaction and the separate appearance controls for each widget.

variant.changelog:
Party Cooldowns
- Added an optional cooldown tracker beside player names in the game's party list.
- Choose up to 12 damage, burst, party buff, defensive, healing, and support cooldowns per job.
- Abilities are organized into collapsible role and job lists. Click to add, drag to reorder, or remove individual choices.
- Includes Salted Earth, Starry Muse, short damage cooldowns, healer recovery tools, shared or transformed abilities, and optional role stuns and interrupts. Unsupported conditional recharges are greyed out with an explanation.
- Added Auto-collapse other jobs beside the visibility checkbox. Switching jobs closes other job and role sections; disable it to keep several expanded.
- Place icons left or right of names, with sizes up to 72 px, adjustable spacing, and horizontal and vertical offsets. Each side saves its own settings.
- Added per-job custom layouts with up to three rows. Drag abilities between rows and choose where clicked additions go. Disabling custom rows remembers the arrangement.
- Added a non-scrolling party-frame preview with a job icon and HP/MP bars. The entire preview shrinks when needed to fit without changing live settings.
- Countdown and charge numbers have black outlines for readability.
- Unknown cooldown history displays ? instead of assuming an ability is ready.
- Tempera Coat and Grassa apply confirmed shield-break reductions: 60 seconds for Coat and 30 for Grassa. Conversion, expiry, overwrite, and death do not count as shield breaks.
- Cooldowns continue through ordinary combat endings and follow confirmed duty resets.

HUD and UI
- Renamed Widgets to HUD, with separate DPS Meter, Death Window, and Party Cooldowns views.
- Renamed Death Widget to Death Window, including its title, settings, and walkthrough.
- Added visible borders and spacing from the window edge to the three HUD section buttons.
- Reorganized settings and previews to accommodate wide and narrow windows.
- Tidied visibility, Normal/Concise display, appearance controls, and previews for the DPS Meter and Death Window.
- Background opacity sliders now display percentages.
- Moved the DPS Meter disclaimer into a collapsible section.
- Fixed missing icons on Help, Punish Discord, reset buttons, and replay death markers.
- Replaced two-line drag handles with dotted grips.
- Improved dragging for cooldown abilities and DPS Meter columns, including reliable placement at the end of a list.
- Expanded the walkthrough with cooldown selection, layout, and preview steps that automatically open the relevant controls.
- Added Party Cooldowns documentation to the website, Help Center, and GitHub page. Updated HUD and Death Window instructions.

Replay
- Party HP and Active Effects now remain in separate, independently resizable panels outside the arena. Compact layouts place them below the arena instead of covering it.
- Added scrolling for overflowing HP, mitigation, and debuff lists. Split mode scrolls each effects list independently.
- The +x more indicator counts entries below the visible area and disappears as they come into view.

Performance and Diagnostics
- Reduced repeated party-data rebuilding and unnecessary updates to fully ready teammate cooldowns.
- Reused display data and cached text measurements.
- Added optional cooldown CPU-time and memory-allocation readings under Debug. Measurement is disabled by default.
